title: As Israeli election looms, Trump advisers see opportunity beyond Netanyahu
summary: President Trump has endorsed Benjamin Netanyahu in Tuesday's Israeli election, but some of his advisers see opportunity for his Middle East agenda in a government led by someone else, U.S. officials tell Axios.
